from enum import Flag, auto

class Perm(Flag):
    READ = auto()
    WRITE = auto()
    EXEC = auto()

def enum_flag(s):
    perms = 0
    for name in s.split('|'):
        perms |= Perm[name.strip().upper()].value
    return perms
